title: Will / going to
note: Thin unit. 8 items for Quiz/Type/Use. will (decide now, promise, request) vs going to (plan, evidence). Gap the whole VP. Stem forces the job (A0). No Match/sort. Not going to work (commute). · 2026-08-29 smoke.

items.en: It is hot in here. I will open the window.
items.gap: It is hot in here. I ____ the window. (open)
accepts: It is hot in here. I will open the window.
It is hot in here. I'll open the window.
It's hot in here. I will open the window.
It's hot in here. I'll open the window.
items.explanation: Hot now → decide now → **will open**. Not a plan.
items.explanation_cz: Horko teď → rozhodnutí teď → **will open**. Ne plán.

items.en: I am thirsty. I will get some water.
items.gap: I am thirsty. I ____ some water. (get)
accepts: I am thirsty. I will get some water.
I am thirsty. I'll get some water.
I'm thirsty. I will get some water.
I'm thirsty. I'll get some water.
Sorry. I won't be late.
Sorry. I will not be late.
Sorry. I'll not be late.

items.en: I can't open this. Will you open the door?
items.gap: I can't open this. ____ the door? (open)
accepts: I can't open this. Will you open the door?
I cannot open this. Will you open the door?
items.explanation: I can't → request now → **Will you open**.

items.en: We have tickets. We are going to watch a film.
items.cz: Máme lístky. Budeme se dívat na film.
items.gap: We have tickets. We ____ a film. (watch)
accepts: We have tickets. We are going to watch a film.
We have tickets. We're going to watch a film.
We have tickets. We are going to watch a movie.
We have tickets. We're going to watch a movie.
items.explanation: Tickets already → plan → **are going to watch**.
items.explanation_cz: Lístky už jsou → plán → **are going to watch**.

items.en: I have a plan. I am going to study tonight.
items.cz: Mám plán. Dnes večer se budu učit.
items.gap: I have a plan. I ____ tonight. (study)
accepts: I have a plan. I am going to study tonight.
I have a plan. I'm going to study tonight.
items.explanation: I have a plan → **am going to study** tonight.
items.explanation_cz: Mám plán → **am going to study** tonight.

items.en: Look at the sky. It is going to rain.
items.cz: Podívej se na oblohu. Bude pršet.
accepts: Look at the sky. It is going to rain.
Look at the sky. It's going to rain.
items.explanation: Look at the sky → evidence now → **is going to rain**.
items.explanation_cz: Podívej se na oblohu → důkaz teď → **is going to rain**.

items.en: Look at the clock. We are going to miss the train.
items.gap: Look at the clock. We ____ the train. (miss)
accepts: Look at the clock. We are going to miss the train.
Look at the clock. We're going to miss the train.
items.explanation: Look at the clock → evidence now → **are going to miss**.
items.explanation_cz: Koukni na hodiny → důkaz teď → **are going to miss**.

cards.title: Will
points: Same for I / she / they: **I will** · **she will**.

examples.en: We are **going to** watch a film.

cards.title: Plan or evidence
points: A plan already in your head → **going to**.
Something you can see now → **going to**.

table.caption: why
rows: We are **going to** watch a film.

I **will** go / I am **going to** go
